record.title: Amounts without a leading zero (.75) are rejected
record.mechanical_flags: Comment says label 'bug'; actual recorded labels are []. A comment does not apply a label.; Comment names src/ingest/schema.ts, but recorded state has no open PR. Check the complete tools and intended decision.
record.actual_decision: The direct implementation read issue #4611 and posted a generic triage comment identifying it as a bug in `src/ingest/schema.ts`. However, it did not apply a bug label, inspect the source code, or open a draft PR. The recorded end state confirms one comment, no labels, and no PRs. The independent source in `src/util/money.ts` shows that the amount-parsing regular expression rejects decimal values without a leading zero.
record.observation: The direct implementation correctly read issue #4611 at step 0 (c1), but then posted only a generic triage comment at step 1 (c2). It identified `src/ingest/schema.ts` as the relevant file without inspecting the source code, applying a bug label, or opening a PR. The recorded end state confirms one comment, no labels, and no PRs. Independent inspection of `src/util/money.ts` shows that the amount-parsing regular expression requires a digit before the decimal point, explaining why values such as `.50` and `-.75` are rejected. I consider this run unsuccessful because it failed to complete the required bug triage.
